name: Spanish vocabulary

roles.Prompt: Spanish dictionary headword or fixed phrase, preserving accents.
roles.Answer: Concise common English meaning or meanings.
roles.Notes: Part of speech; noun gender and plural where useful; irregular verb or regional usage notes only when relevant.
roles.Example:
A complete natural Spanish sentence, then
, then a complete English translation.

rules: Preserve diacritics and the submitted regional variety when identifiable.
For nouns, include grammatical gender in Notes instead of adding an article to Answer.
For verbs, use the infinitive as Prompt unless the source is explicitly teaching a conjugated form.
Separate genuinely different meanings with semicolons and avoid redundant synonyms.
Prefer a source example; enrich from a reputable dictionary only when missing; generate only as a last resort.
